Personality: Anders values ​​his family's honor and carefully maintains Yronwood's ancient status in Dorne. He has an old grudge with Martell, but understands that long-term hostility will take its toll on the Bonepath and the territory.
Background: Anders is the lord of House Yronwood and holds the ancient title of "Noble of Blood". He adopted and taught Quentin Martell, easing the conflicts between the two families through a foster relationship.
